## 4. Parental leave
4.1 The primary caregiver is entitled to **16 weeks** of fully paid parental
leave.
4.2 The secondary caregiver is entitled to **4 weeks** of fully paid parental
leave, which must be taken within **12 months** of the birth or placement.
4.3 Parental leave may be taken in up to **three** separate blocks with the
agreement of the line manager.
4.4 Annual leave continues to accrue during parental leave.
4.5 Staff must give **8 weeks** notice of their intended start date where
practicable.
## 5. Unpaid leave
5.1 Unpaid leave of up to **20 working days** per year may be granted at the
discretion of a Head of Department.
5.2 Unpaid leave does not count toward continuous service for the purposes of
clause 1.2.

# Annual and Parental Leave Policy — Shore Staff
**Policy reference:** HR-04 · **Effective:** 1 January 2026 · **Review:** annually
## 1. Annual leave entitlement
1.1 Shore-based staff accrue **22 days** of paid annual leave per calendar year,
accruing at 1.83 days per completed month of service.
1.2 Staff with more than **five years** of continuous service accrue **26 days**
per calendar year.
1.3 Part-time staff accrue leave pro rata, rounded up to the nearest half day.
1.4 Public holidays are additional and are not deducted from annual leave.
## 2. Carry-over
2.1 A maximum of **5 days** of unused annual leave may be carried into the
following calendar year.
2.2 Carried-over leave must be taken by **31 March** or it is forfeited.

# Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy
**Policy reference:** FIN-11 · **Effective:** 1 January 2026
## 1. Per-diem allowances
1.1 Domestic travel attracts a per-diem of **EUR 65** per full day.
1.2 International travel attracts a per-diem of **EUR 95** per full day.
1.3 Travel to designated high-cost ports (Singapore, Oslo, Tokyo, Zurich)
attracts a per-diem of **EUR 130** per full day.
1.4 A part day of **6 hours or more** is claimed at 50% of the applicable rate.
A part day under 6 hours is not claimable.
## 2. Receipts
2.1 Receipts are required for any single item of **EUR 40 or more**.
2.2 Items under EUR 40 may be claimed without a receipt up to a monthly
aggregate of **EUR 200**.
2.3 Claims submitted without required receipts are rejected and returned.
## 3. Accommodation

2.2 Items under EUR 40 may be claimed without a receipt up to a monthly

2.3 Claims submitted without required receipts are rejected and returned.
## 3. Accommodation
3.1 Accommodation is reimbursed at cost up to **EUR 180** per night domestic and
**EUR 260** per night international.
3.2 Bookings above these caps require advance written approval from the budget
holder.
## 4. Transport
4.1 Economy class is the standard for all flights under **6 hours**.
4.2 Premium economy may be booked for flights of 6 hours or more with budget
holder approval.
4.3 Private car use is reimbursed at **EUR 0.38 per kilometre**.
4.4 Taxi fares are reimbursed where public transport is unavailable or where the
journey falls between 22:00 and 06:00.
